verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: נְקֹ֗ם נִקְמַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאֵ֖ת הַמִּדְיָנִ֑ים אַחַ֖ר תֵּאָסֵ֥ף אֶל־ עַמֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: nə·qōm niq·maṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mê·’êṯ ham·miḏ·yā·nîm ’a·ḥar tê·’ā·sêp̄ ’el- ‘am·me·ḵā
verses.literal: Take vengeance . . . on the Midianites for the Israelites . . . After that you will be gathered to your people
verses.literalPt: Vinga os filhos de Israel dos midianitas; depois, serás recolhido ao teu povo.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ הָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר הֵחָלְצ֧וּ מֵאִתְּכֶ֛ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לַצָּבָ֑א וְיִהְיוּ֙ עַל־ מִדְיָ֔ן לָתֵ֥ת נִקְמַת־ יְהוָ֖ה בְּמִדְיָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr mō·šeh ’el- hā·‘ām lê·mōr hê·ḥā·lə·ṣū mê·’it·tə·ḵem ’ă·nā·šîm laṣ·ṣā·ḇā wə·yih·yū ‘al- miḏ·yān lā·ṯêṯ niq·maṯ- Yah·weh bə·miḏ·yān
verses.literal: So Moses told . . . the people . . . Arm . . . some of your men for war that they may go against the Midianites and execute the LORD’s vengeance on them
verses.literalPt: Então, disse Moisés ao povo: Armai homens dentre vós para a guerra, a fim de que saiam contra Midiã, para executarem a vingança de Jeová contra eles.

verses.original: אֶ֚לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֔ה אֶ֖לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֑ה לְכֹל֙ מַטּ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תִּשְׁלְח֖וּ לַצָּבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·lep̄ lam·maṭ·ṭeh ’e·lep̄ lam·maṭ·ṭeh lə·ḵōl maṭ·ṭō·wṯ yiś·rā·’êl tiš·lə·ḥū laṣ·ṣā·ḇā
verses.literal: Send into battle a thousand men from each tribe of Israel - . . .
verses.literalPt: Enviareis à guerra mil homens de cada tribo entre todas as tribos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּמָּֽסְרוּ֙ מֵאַלְפֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶ֖לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֑ה שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲלוּצֵ֥י צָבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·mā·sə·rū mê·’al·p̄ê yiś·rā·’êl ’e·lep̄ lam·maṭ·ṭeh šə·nêm- ‘ā·śār ’e·lep̄ ḥă·lū·ṣê ṣā·ḇā
verses.literal: So a thousand men were recruited from each tribe of Israel twelve . . . thousand armed for war
verses.literalPt: Assim, dos milhares de Israel foram entregues mil homens de cada tribo, doze mil armados para a guerra.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח אֹתָ֥ם מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶ֥לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֖ה לַצָּבָ֑א אֹ֠תָם וְאֶת־ פִּ֨ינְחָ֜ס בֶּן־ אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ לַצָּבָ֔א וּכְלֵ֥י הַקֹּ֛דֶשׁ וַחֲצֹצְר֥וֹת הַתְּרוּעָ֖ה בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ’ō·ṯām mō·šeh ’e·lep̄ lam·maṭ·ṭeh laṣ·ṣā·ḇā ’ō·ṯām wə·’eṯ- pî·nə·ḥās ben- ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên laṣ·ṣā·ḇā ū·ḵə·lê haq·qō·ḏeš wa·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ hat·tə·rū·‘āh bə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: And Moses sent the thousand from each tribe into battle along with Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest . . . who took with him the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for signaling
verses.literalPt: Moisés os enviou à guerra, mil de cada tribo, com Fineias, filho do sacerdote Eleazar, o qual tinha na mão os objetos sagrados e as trombetas para tocar alarme.

verses.original: וַֽיִּצְבְּאוּ֙ עַל־ מִדְיָ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיַּֽהַרְג֖וּ כָּל־ זָכָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·bə·’ū ‘al- miḏ·yān ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh way·ya·har·ḡū kāl- zā·ḵār
verses.literal: Then they waged war against Midian as the LORD had commanded Moses and they killed every male
verses.literalPt: Pelejaram contra Midiã, como Jeová ordenou a Moisés, e mataram todos os homens.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ מַלְכֵ֨י מִדְיָ֜ן הָרְג֣וּ עַל־ חַלְלֵיהֶ֗ם אֶת־ אֱוִ֤י וְאֶת־ רֶ֙קֶם֙ וְאֶת־ צ֤וּר וְאֶת־ חוּר֙ וְאֶת־ רֶ֔בַע חֲמֵ֖שֶׁת מַלְכֵ֣י מִדְיָ֑ן וְאֵת֙ בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ בְּע֔וֹר הָרְג֖וּ בֶּחָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- mal·ḵê miḏ·yān hā·rə·ḡū ‘al- ḥal·lê·hem ’eṯ- ’ĕ·wî wə·’eṯ- re·qem wə·’eṯ- ṣūr wə·’eṯ- ḥūr wə·’eṯ- re·ḇa‘ ḥă·mê·šeṯ mal·ḵê miḏ·yān wə·’êṯ bil·‘ām ben- bə·‘ō·wr hā·rə·ḡū be·ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: Among the slain were - Evi Rekem Zur Hur and Reba the five kings of Midian They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword
verses.literalPt: Com os que foram mortos deles mataram também aos reis de Midiã, a saber, Evi, Requém, Zur, Hur e Reba, cinco reis de Midiã; mataram com a espada igualmente a Balaão, filho de Beor.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁבּ֧וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ נְשֵׁ֥י מִדְיָ֖ן וְאֶת־ טַפָּ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ בְּהֶמְתָּ֧ם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ מִקְנֵהֶ֛ם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֵילָ֖ם בָּזָֽזוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·bū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- nə·šê miḏ·yān wə·’eṯ- ṭap·pām wə·’êṯ kāl- bə·hem·tām wə·’eṯ- kāl- miq·nê·hem wə·’eṯ- kāl- ḥê·lām bā·zā·zū
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . captured the Midianite women and their children and they plundered all their herds - flocks - and goods
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Israel levaram cativas as mulheres de Midiã com os seus pequeninos; e despojaram-nos de todos os seus gados, de todos os seus rebanhos e de todos os seus bens.

verses.original: וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־ עָרֵיהֶם֙ בְּמ֣וֹשְׁבֹתָ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ טִֽירֹתָ֑ם שָׂרְפ֖וּ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ kāl- ‘ā·rê·hem bə·mō·wō·šə·ḇō·ṯām wə·’êṯ kāl- ṭî·rō·ṯām śā·rə·p̄ū bā·’êš
verses.literal: Then they burned . . . all the cities where the Midianites had lived as well as all their encampments
verses.literalPt: Queimaram-lhes a fogo todas as cidades em que habitavam e todos os acampamentos.

verses.original: וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַשָּׁלָ֔ל וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ הַמַּלְק֑וֹחַ בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ḥū ’eṯ- kāl- haš·šā·lāl wə·’êṯ kāl- ham·mal·qō·w·aḥ bā·’ā·ḏām ū·ḇab·bə·hê·māh
verses.literal: and carried away all the plunder and spoils both people and animals
verses.literalPt: Levaram todo o despojo e toda a presa, tanto de homens como de animais.

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֡אוּ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֩ וְאֶל־ אֶלְעָזָ֨ר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְאֶל־ עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶת־ הַשְּׁבִ֧י וְאֶת־ הַמַּלְק֛וֹחַ וְאֶת־ הַשָּׁלָ֖ל אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה אֶל־ עַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇi·’ū ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·’el- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- haš·šə·ḇî wə·’eṯ- ham·mal·qō·w·aḥ wə·’eṯ- haš·šā·lāl ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh ’el- ‘ar·ḇōṯ mō·w·’āḇ ’ă·šer ‘al- yar·dên yə·rê·ḥōw
verses.literal: They brought the captives spoils and plunder to Moses to Eleazar the priest and to the congregation . . . of Israel at the camp on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho
verses.literalPt: Trouxeram os cativos, e a presa, e o despojo a Moisés, e ao sacerdote Eleazar, e à congregação dos filhos de Israel, ao arraial, nas planícies de Moabe, que estão junto ao Jordão, na altura de Jericó.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨צְא֜וּ מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן וְכָל־ נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לִקְרָאתָ֑ם אֶל־ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣə·’ū mō·šeh wə·’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·ḵāl nə·śî·’ê hā·‘ê·ḏāh liq·rā·ṯām ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: And Moses Eleazar the priest and all the leaders of the congregation went to meet them . . . outside the camp
verses.literalPt: Saíram a recebê-los fora do arraial Moisés, e o sacerdote Eleazar, e todos os príncipes da congregação.

verses.original: וַיִּקְצֹ֣ף מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַ֖ל פְּקוּדֵ֣י הֶחָ֑יִל שָׂרֵ֤י הָאֲלָפִים֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֔וֹת הַבָּאִ֖ים מִצְּבָ֥א הַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ṣōp̄ mō·šeh ‘al pə·qū·ḏê he·ḥā·yil śā·rê hā·’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·śā·rê ham·mê·’ō·wṯ hab·bā·’îm miṣ·ṣə·ḇā ham·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: But Moses was angry with the officers of the army the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds who were returning from the battle
verses.literalPt: Indignou-se Moisés contra os oficiais do exército, capitães dos milhares e capitães das centenas que vinham do serviço da guerra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֹשֶׁ֑ה הַֽחִיִּיתֶ֖ם כָּל־ נְקֵבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem mō·šeh ha·ḥî·yî·ṯem kāl- nə·qê·ḇāh
verses.literal: Have you spared all the women he asked them . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes Moisés: Deixastes viver todas as mulheres?

verses.original: הֵ֣ן הֵ֜נָּה הָי֨וּ לִבְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בִּדְבַ֣ר בִּלְעָ֔ם לִמְסָר־ מַ֥עַל בַּיהוָ֖ה עַל־ דְּבַר־ פְּע֑וֹר וַתְּהִ֥י הַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה בַּעֲדַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hên hên·nāh hā·yū liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl biḏ·ḇar bil·‘ām lim·sār- ma·‘al Yah·weh ‘al- də·ḇar- pə·‘ō·wr wat·tə·hî ham·mag·gê·p̄āh ba·‘ă·ḏaṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Look these women caused the sons of Israel through the counsel of Balaam to turn unfaithfully against the LORD at Peor so that the plague struck the congregation of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Eis que estas, por conselho de Balaão, fizeram que os filhos de Israel pecassem contra Jeová no negócio de Peor, e assim houve a praga entre a congregação de Jeová.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה הִרְג֥וּ כָל־ זָכָ֖ר בַּטָּ֑ף וְכָל־ אִשָּׁ֗ה יֹדַ֥עַת אִ֛ישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּ֥ב זָכָ֖ר הֲרֹֽגוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hir·ḡū ḵāl zā·ḵār baṭ·ṭāp̄ wə·ḵāl ’iš·šāh yō·ḏa·‘aṯ ’îš lə·miš·kaḇ zā·ḵār hă·rō·ḡū
verses.literal: So now kill all the boys . . . as well as every woman who has had relations with . . . . . . a man
verses.literalPt: Agora, matai a todos os machos entre os pequeninos e matai as mulheres que conheceram homem, deitando-se com ele.

verses.original: וְכֹל֙ הַטַּ֣ף בַּנָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ יָדְע֖וּ מִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר הַחֲי֖וּ לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl haṭ·ṭap̄ ban·nā·šîm ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏə·‘ū miš·kaḇ zā·ḵār ha·ḥă·yū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: but spare for yourselves every girl . . . who has never had relations . . . with a man
verses.literalPt: Porém as meninas que não conheceram homem, deitando-se com ele, deixai-as viver para vós.

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֗ם חֲנ֛וּ מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים כֹּל֩ הֹרֵ֨ג נֶ֜פֶשׁ וְכֹ֣ל׀ נֹגֵ֣עַ בֶּֽחָלָ֗ל תִּֽתְחַטְּא֞וּ בַּיּ֤וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י אַתֶּ֖ם וּשְׁבִיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem ḥă·nū mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm kōl hō·rêḡ ne·p̄eš wə·ḵōl nō·ḡê·a‘ be·ḥā·lāl tiṯ·ḥaṭ·ṭə·’ū bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î ’at·tem ū·šə·ḇî·ḵem
verses.literal: All of you who have killed a person . . . or touched the dead are to remain outside the camp for seven days On the third day and the seventh day you are to purify both yourselves and your captives
verses.literalPt: Acampai-vos fora do arraial por sete dias; quem de vós tiver matado alguma pessoa, e quem tiver tocado em algum morto, ao terceiro dia e ao sétimo dia purificai-vos a vós e aos vossos cativos.

verses.original: וְכָל־ בֶּ֧גֶד וְכָל־ כְּלִי־ ע֛וֹר וְכָל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה עִזִּ֖ים וְכָל־ כְּלִי־ עֵ֑ץ תִּתְחַטָּֽאוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl be·ḡeḏ wə·ḵāl kə·lî- ‘ō·wr wə·ḵāl ma·‘ă·śêh ‘iz·zîm wə·ḵāl kə·lî- ‘êṣ tiṯ·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’ū
verses.literal: And purify every garment and leather . . . good everything made of goat’s hair and every article of wood
verses.literalPt: No tocante a todo vestido, e a tudo o que se faz de peles, e a toda obra de pelos de cabras, e a tudo o que se faz de madeira, vos purificareis a vós mesmos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶל־ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַצָּבָ֔א הַבָּאִ֖ים לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה זֹ֚את חֻקַּ֣ת הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên ’el- ’an·šê haṣ·ṣā·ḇā hab·bā·’îm lam·mil·ḥā·māh zōṯ ḥuq·qaṯ hat·tō·w·rāh ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: Then Eleazar the priest said to the soldiers . . . who had gone into battle This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: Então, Eleazar, o sacerdote, disse aos homens de guerra que foram à peleja: Este é o estatuto da lei que Jeová ordenou a Moisés:

verses.original: אַ֥ךְ אֶת־ הַזָּהָ֖ב וְאֶת־ הַכָּ֑סֶף אֶֽת־ הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ אֶת־ הַבַּרְזֶ֔ל אֶֽת־ הַבְּדִ֖יל וְאֶת־ הָעֹפָֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ wə·’eṯ- hak·kā·sep̄ ’eṯ- han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ’eṯ- hab·bar·zel ’eṯ- hab·bə·ḏîl wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ō·p̄ā·reṯ
verses.literal: Only the gold silver bronze iron tin and lead
verses.literalPt: o ouro, a prata, o cobre, o ferro, o estanho e o chumbo,

verses.original: כָּל־ דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ יָבֹ֣א בָאֵ֗שׁ תַּעֲבִ֤ירוּ בָאֵשׁ֙ וְטָהֵ֔ר אַ֕ךְ בְּמֵ֥י נִדָּ֖ה יִתְחַטָּ֑א וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ יָבֹ֛א בָּאֵ֖שׁ תַּעֲבִ֥ירוּ בַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- yā·ḇō ḇā·’êš ta·‘ă·ḇî·rū ḇā·’êš wə·ṭā·hêr ’aḵ bə·mê nid·dāh yiṯ·ḥaṭ·ṭā wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḇō bā·’êš ta·‘ă·ḇî·rū ḇam·mā·yim
verses.literal: everything . . . that can withstand the fire must be put through the fire and it will be clean But it must still be purified with the water of purification And everything that cannot withstand the fire must pass through the water
verses.literalPt: tudo o que pode resistir ao fogo, fá-lo-eis passar pelo fogo e ficará limpo; todavia, será purificado com a água de purificação; e tudo o que não pode resistir o fogo, fá-lo-eis passar pela água.

verses.original: וְכִבַּסְתֶּ֧ם בִּגְדֵיכֶ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י וּטְהַרְתֶּ֑ם וְאַחַ֖ר תָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵib·bas·tem biḡ·ḏê·ḵem bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î ū·ṭə·har·tem wə·’a·ḥar tā·ḇō·’ū ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: On the seventh day you are to wash your clothes and you will be clean After that you may enter . . . the camp
verses.literalPt: Lavareis os vossos vestidos ao sétimo dia, e estareis limpos, e depois entrareis no arraial.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: The LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: שָׂ֗א אֵ֣ת רֹ֤אשׁ מַלְק֙וֹחַ֙ הַשְּׁבִ֔י בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֑ה אַתָּה֙ וְאֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְרָאשֵׁ֖י אֲב֥וֹת הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: śā ’êṯ rōš mal·qō·w·aḥ haš·šə·ḇî bā·’ā·ḏām ū·ḇab·bə·hê·māh ’at·tāh wə·’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·rā·šê ’ă·ḇō·wṯ hā·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the congregation are to take a count - of what was captured . . . both of man and beast
verses.literalPt: Tira a soma da presa que foi tomada, tanto de homens como de animais, tu, e o sacerdote Eleazar, e os cabeças das casas dos pais da congregação.

verses.original: וְחָצִ֙יתָ֙ אֶת־ הַמַּלְק֔וֹחַ בֵּ֚ין תֹּפְשֵׂ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים לַצָּבָ֑א וּבֵ֖ין כָּל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥā·ṣî·ṯā ’eṯ- ham·mal·qō·w·aḥ bên tō·p̄ə·śê ham·mil·ḥā·māh hay·yō·ṣə·’îm laṣ·ṣā·ḇā ū·ḇên kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: Then divide the captives between the troops . . . who went out to battle . . . and the rest of the congregation
verses.literalPt: Divide a presa em duas partes iguais, entre os homens versados na guerra que saíram à peleja e toda a congregação;

verses.original: וַהֲרֵמֹתָ֨ מֶ֜כֶס לַֽיהוָ֗ה מֵאֵ֞ת אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ הַיֹּצְאִ֣ים לַצָּבָ֔א אֶחָ֣ד נֶ֔פֶשׁ מֵחֲמֵ֖שׁ הַמֵּא֑וֹת מִן־ הָאָדָם֙ וּמִן־ הַבָּקָ֔ר וּמִן־ הַחֲמֹרִ֖ים וּמִן־ הַצֹּֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·rê·mō·ṯā me·ḵes Yah·weh mê·’êṯ ’an·šê ham·mil·ḥā·māh hay·yō·ṣə·’îm laṣ·ṣā·ḇā ’e·ḥāḏ ne·p̄eš mê·ḥă·mêš ham·mê·’ō·wṯ min- hā·’ā·ḏām ū·min- hab·bā·qār ū·min- ha·ḥă·mō·rîm ū·min- haṣ·ṣōn
verses.literal: Set aside a tribute for the LORD from what belongs to the soldiers . . . who went into battle one . . . out of every five hundred whether persons cattle . . . donkeys . . . or sheep
verses.literalPt: toma um tributo para Jeová dos homens de guerra que saíram à peleja; um em quinhentos, assim dos homens como dos bois, e dos jumentos, e dos rebanhos.

verses.original: מִמַּֽחֲצִיתָ֖ם תִּקָּ֑חוּ וְנָתַתָּ֛ה לְאֶלְעָזָ֥ר הַכֹּהֵ֖ן תְּרוּמַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mim·ma·ḥă·ṣî·ṯām tiq·qā·ḥū wə·nā·ṯat·tāh lə·’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên tə·rū·maṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Take it from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest as an offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Toma-o da sua metade e dá-o ao sacerdote Eleazar para a oferta alçada a Jeová.

verses.original: וּמִמַּחֲצִ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל תִּקַּ֣ח׀ אֶחָ֣ד׀ אָחֻ֣ז מִן־ הַחֲמִשִּׁ֗ים מִן־ הָאָדָ֧ם מִן־ הַבָּקָ֛ר מִן־ הַחֲמֹרִ֥ים וּמִן־ הַצֹּ֖אן מִכָּל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אֹתָם֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם שֹׁמְרֵ֕י מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת מִשְׁכַּ֥ן יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mim·ma·ḥă·ṣiṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl tiq·qaḥ ’e·ḥāḏ ’ā·ḥuz min- ha·ḥă·miš·šîm min- hā·’ā·ḏām min- hab·bā·qār min- ha·ḥă·mō·rîm ū·min- haṣ·ṣōn mik·kāl hab·bə·hê·māh wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’ō·ṯām lal·wî·yim šō·mə·rê miš·me·reṯ miš·kan Yah·weh
verses.literal: From the Israelites’ . . . half take one . . . out of every fifty whether persons cattle . . . donkeys . . . sheep or other animals and give them to the Levites who keep charge of the tabernacle of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Da metade que pertence aos filhos de Israel, tomarás um de cada cinquenta, dos homens, dos bois, dos jumentos, dos rebanhos e de todo o gado e dá-los-ás aos levitas, que cumprem o serviço que é devido ao tabernáculo de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś mō·šeh wə·’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: Fizeram Moisés e Eleazar, o sacerdote, como Jeová ordenou a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ הַמַּלְק֔וֹחַ יֶ֣תֶר הַבָּ֔ז אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּזְז֖וּ עַ֣ם הַצָּבָ֑א צֹ֗אן שֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵֽשֶׁת־ אֲלָפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ham·mal·qō·w·aḥ ye·ṯer hab·bāz ’ă·šer bā·zə·zū ‘am haṣ·ṣā·ḇā ṣōn šêš- mê·’ō·wṯ ’e·lep̄ wə·šiḇ·‘îm ’e·lep̄ wa·ḥă·mê·šeṯ- ’ă·lā·p̄îm
verses.literal: and this plunder remained from the spoils the soldiers . . . had taken 675,000 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . sheep
verses.literalPt: Ora, foi a presa que restava do despojo que tomaram os homens de guerra seiscentas e setenta e cinco mil ovelhas,

verses.original: וּבָקָ֕ר שְׁנַ֥יִם וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·qār šə·na·yim wə·šiḇ·‘îm ’ā·lep̄
verses.literalPt: setenta e dois mil bois,

verses.original: וַחֲמֹרִ֕ים אֶחָ֥ד וְשִׁשִּׁ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: wa·ḥă·mō·rîm ’e·ḥāḏ wə·šiš·šîm ’ā·lep̄
verses.literalPt: sessenta e um mil jumentos

verses.original: וְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם מִן־ הַ֨נָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יָדְע֖וּ מִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר כָּל־ נֶ֕פֶשׁ שְׁנַ֥יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ne·p̄eš ’ā·ḏām min- han·nā·šîm ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏə·‘ū miš·kaḇ zā·ḵār kāl- ne·p̄eš šə·na·yim ū·šə·lō·šîm ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: and - 32,000 . . . . . . - women who had not slept with . . . a man
verses.literalPt: e trinta e duas mil pessoas ao todo, das mulheres que não tinham conhecido homem, deitando-se com ele.

verses.original: וַתְּהִי֙ הַֽמֶּחֱצָ֔ה חֵ֕לֶק הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים בַּצָּבָ֑א מִסְפַּ֣ר הַצֹּ֗אן שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וְשִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî ham·me·ḥĕ·ṣāh ḥê·leq hay·yō·ṣə·’îm baṣ·ṣā·ḇā mis·par haṣ·ṣōn šə·lōš- mê·’ō·wṯ ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·lō·šîm ’e·lep̄ wə·šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: This was the half portion for those who had gone to war 337,500 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . sheep
verses.literalPt: A metade, que era a porção dos que saíram à guerra, foi em número de trezentas e trinta e sete mil e quinhentas ovelhas;

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י הַמֶּ֥כֶס לַֽיהוָ֖ה מִן־ הַצֹּ֑אן שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חָמֵ֥שׁ וְשִׁבְעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ham·me·ḵes Yah·weh min- haṣ·ṣōn šêš mê·’ō·wṯ ḥā·mêš wə·šiḇ·‘îm
verses.literal: including a tribute to the LORD of 675 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: das ovelhas, foi o tributo para Jeová seiscentas e setenta e cinco.

verses.original: וְהַ֨בָּקָ֔ר שִׁשָּׁ֥ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וּמִכְסָ֥ם לַיהוָ֖ה שְׁנַ֥יִם וְשִׁבְעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·bā·qār šiš·šāh ū·šə·lō·šîm ’ā·lep̄ ū·miḵ·sām Yah·weh šə·na·yim wə·šiḇ·‘îm
verses.literal: 36,000 . . . . . . cattle including a tribute to the LORD of 72 . . .
verses.literalPt: Os bois foram trinta e seis mil, dos quais foi o tributo para Jeová setenta e dois.

verses.original: וַחֲמֹרִ֕ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וּמִכְסָ֥ם לַֽיהוָ֖ה אֶחָ֥ד וְשִׁשִּֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wa·ḥă·mō·rîm šə·lō·šîm ’e·lep̄ wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ ū·miḵ·sām Yah·weh ’e·ḥāḏ wə·šiš·šîm
verses.literal: 30,500 . . . . . . . . . donkeys including a tribute to the LORD of 61 . . .
verses.literalPt: Os jumentos foram trinta mil e quinhentos, dos quais foi o tributo para Jeová sessenta e um.

verses.original: וְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף וּמִכְסָם֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה שְׁנַ֥יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ne·p̄eš ’ā·ḏām šiš·šāh ‘ā·śār ’ā·lep̄ ū·miḵ·sām Yah·weh šə·na·yim ū·šə·lō·šîm nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: and 16,000 . . . . . . people . . . including a tribute to the LORD of 32 . . .
verses.literalPt: As pessoas foram dezesseis mil, das quais foi o tributo para Jeová trinta e duas pessoas.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶת־ מֶ֙כֶס֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְאֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên mō·šeh ’eṯ- me·ḵes tə·rū·maṯ Yah·weh lə·’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: Moses gave the tribute to Eleazar the priest as an offering for the LORD as the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: Então, Moisés deu o tributo, que era a oferta alçada para Jeová, ao sacerdote Eleazar, como Jeová ordenou a Moisés.

verses.original: וּמִֽמַּחֲצִ֖ית בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ חָצָ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִן־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים הַצֹּבְאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mim·ma·ḥă·ṣîṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer ḥā·ṣāh mō·šeh min- hā·’ă·nā·šîm haṣ·ṣō·ḇə·’îm
verses.literal: From the Israelites’ . . . half which Moses had set apart from the men who had gone to war
verses.literalPt: Da metade que era dos filhos de Israel, separada por Moisés da dos homens que pelejaram

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֛י מֶחֱצַ֥ת הָעֵדָ֖ה מִן־ הַצֹּ֑אן שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî me·ḥĕ·ṣaṯ hā·‘ê·ḏāh min- haṣ·ṣōn šə·lōš- mê·’ō·wṯ ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·lō·šîm ’e·lep̄ šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: this half belonged to the congregation . . . 337,500 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . sheep
verses.literalPt: (ora, foi a metade que era da congregação trezentas e trinta e sete mil e quinhentas ovelhas,

verses.original: וּבָקָ֕ר שִׁשָּׁ֥ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·qār šiš·šāh ū·šə·lō·šîm ’ā·lep̄
verses.literalPt: trinta e seis mil bois,

verses.original: וַחֲמֹרִ֕ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wa·ḥă·mō·rîm šə·lō·šîm ’e·lep̄ wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literalPt: trinta mil e quinhentos jumentos

verses.original: וְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ne·p̄eš ’ā·ḏām šiš·šāh ‘ā·śār ’ā·lep̄
verses.literalPt: e dezesseis mil pessoas);

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה מִמַּחֲצִ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶת־ הָֽאָחֻז֙ אֶחָ֣ד מִן־ הַחֲמִשִּׁ֔ים מִן־ הָאָדָ֖ם וּמִן־ הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֹתָ֜ם לַלְוִיִּ֗ם שֹֽׁמְרֵי֙ מִשְׁמֶ֙רֶת֙ מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ mō·šeh mim·ma·ḥă·ṣiṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ḥuz ’e·ḥāḏ min- ha·ḥă·miš·šîm min- hā·’ā·ḏām ū·min- hab·bə·hê·māh way·yit·tên ’ō·ṯām lal·wî·yim šō·mə·rê miš·me·reṯ miš·kan Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: From the Israelites’ . . . half Moses took one out of every fifty persons and animals and gave them to the Levites who kept charge of the tabernacle of the LORD as the LORD had commanded him
verses.literalPt: sim, da metade que era dos filhos de Israel, tomou Moisés um de cada cinquenta, tanto dos homens como dos animais e deu-os aos levitas, que cumprem o serviço que é devido ao tabernáculo de Jeová; como Jeová ordenou a Moisés.

verses.original: וַֽיִּקְרְבוּ֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה הַפְּקֻדִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאַלְפֵ֣י הַצָּבָ֑א שָׂרֵ֥י הָאֲלָפִ֖ים וְשָׂרֵ֥י הַמֵּאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rə·ḇū ’el- mō·šeh hap·pə·qu·ḏîm ’ă·šer lə·’al·p̄ê haṣ·ṣā·ḇā śā·rê hā·’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·śā·rê ham·mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then the officers who were over the units of the army the commanders of thousands . . . and of hundreds approached . . . Moses
verses.literalPt: Então, chegaram-se a Moisés os oficiais que estavam sobre os milhares do exército, os capitães de mil e os capitães de cem;

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ נָֽשְׂא֗וּ אֶת־ רֹ֛אשׁ אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיָדֵ֑נוּ וְלֹא־ נִפְקַ֥ד מִמֶּ֖נּוּ אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’el- mō·šeh ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā nā·śə·’ū ’eṯ- rōš ’an·šê ham·mil·ḥā·māh ’ă·šer bə·yā·ḏê·nū wə·lō- nip̄·qaḏ mim·men·nū ’îš
verses.literal: and said . . . Your servants have counted - the soldiers - under our command and not one of us is missing
verses.literalPt: e disseram-lhe: Teus servos tiraram a soma dos homens de guerra que estiveram debaixo da nossa autoridade; e não falta nenhum de nós.

verses.original: וַנַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת־ קָרְבַּ֣ן יְהוָ֗ה אִישׁ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָצָ֤א כְלִֽי־ זָהָב֙ אֶצְעָדָ֣ה וְצָמִ֔יד טַבַּ֖עַת עָגִ֣יל וְכוּמָ֑ז לְכַפֵּ֥ר עַל־ נַפְשֹׁתֵ֖ינוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wan·naq·rêḇ ’eṯ- qā·rə·ban Yah·weh ’îš ’ă·šer mā·ṣā ḵə·lî- zā·hāḇ ’eṣ·‘ā·ḏāh wə·ṣā·mîḏ ṭab·ba·‘aṯ ‘ā·ḡîl wə·ḵū·māz lə·ḵap·pêr ‘al- nap̄·šō·ṯê·nū lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: So we have brought to the LORD an offering of the gold articles each man acquired armlets bracelets rings earrings and necklaces to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Pelo que trouxemos a oblação de Jeová, o que cada um achou, de objetos de ouro, ornamentos para o braço, braceletes, anéis, arrecadas e colares, para fazermos expiação por nós mesmos diante de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־ הַזָּהָ֖ב מֵֽאִתָּ֑ם כֹּ֖ל כְּלִ֥י מַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ mō·šeh wə·’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ mê·’it·tām kōl kə·lî ma·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: So Moses and Eleazar the priest received from them all the articles made out of gold
verses.literalPt: Moisés e o sacerdote Eleazar receberam deles o ouro, a saber, os objetos feitos de ouro.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כָּל־ זְהַ֣ב הַתְּרוּמָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵרִ֙ימוּ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה שִׁשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֛לֶף שְׁבַע־ מֵא֥וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שָׁ֑קֶל מֵאֵת֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָֽאֲלָפִ֔ים וּמֵאֵ֖ת שָׂרֵ֥י הַמֵּאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kāl- zə·haḇ hat·tə·rū·māh ’ă·šer hê·rî·mū Yah·weh šiš·šāh ‘ā·śār ’e·lep̄ šə·ḇa‘- mê·’ō·wṯ wa·ḥă·miš·šîm šā·qel mê·’êṯ śā·rê hā·’ă·lā·p̄îm ū·mê·’êṯ śā·rê ham·mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: All the gold that the commanders of thousands . . . . . . and of hundreds presented as an offering to the LORD weighed 16,750 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . shekels . . .
verses.literalPt: Foi todo o ouro da oferta alçada que os capitães de mil e os capitães de cem ofereceram a Jeová dezesseis mil e setecentos e cinquenta siclos

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁי֙ הַצָּבָ֔א בָּזְז֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê haṣ·ṣā·ḇā bā·zə·zū ’îš lōw
verses.literal: Each of the soldiers . . . had taken plunder for himself
verses.literalPt: (pois os homens de guerra haviam tomado despojo, cada um para si).

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־ הַזָּהָ֔ב מֵאֵ֛ת שָׂרֵ֥י הָאֲלָפִ֖ים וְהַמֵּא֑וֹת וַיָּבִ֤אוּ אֹתוֹ֙ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד זִכָּר֥וֹן לִבְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ mō·šeh wə·’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ mê·’êṯ śā·rê hā·’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·ham·mê·’ō·wṯ way·yā·ḇi·’ū ’ō·ṯōw ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ zik·kā·rō·wn liḇ·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: And Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold . . . from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds and brought it into the Tent of Meeting as a memorial for the Israelites . . . before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Moisés e o sacerdote Eleazar receberam o ouro dos capitães de mil e dos capitães de cem e meteram-no na tenda da revelação, para memorial dos filhos de Israel diante de Jeová.
